title: Trucker's UFO sighting and missing time, from Texas to Nevada government land
place_text: Left I-20 near El Paso, Texas; ended up on government property in Nevada, USA

tellings.quote: I thought I was in Texas, you know. No, you're in Nevada. [laughter]

plain: In 1977, a trucker and Air Force veteran known only as Michael says he left Interstate 20 near El Paso, Texas, after seeing a UFO, lost a stretch of time he can't account for, and came to on government land in Nevada. He tells it himself, remembering that he thought he was still in Texas until someone told him: "No, you're in Nevada." If true, it would mean he was carried hundreds of miles without knowing it.
